title: Quenched Peppery Italian Peppers Carbonara
description: A rich and dense take on the classic Italian pasta dish, featuring roasted peppers as the primary flavor component, and a raw egg mixture to add creaminess. This whole30-friendly version eschews traditional cheese and uses a mortar-pestle to pound the ingredients for a coarser texture.

ingredients.name: 4 large Italian peppers
ingredients.notes: Assorted colors, such as red, yellow, orange, green.

ingredients.name: 12 oz spaghetti
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, 100% durum wheat semolina pasta.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup raw pasture-raised chicken broth
ingredients.notes: You can also use beef or vegetable broth if you prefer.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Use the stems and leaves, not just the leaves.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup chopped fresh basil
ingredients.notes: Use the stems and leaves, not just the leaves.

instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat, then add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring occasionally.
Add the sliced peppers to the skillet, in batches if necessary, and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they are tender and slightly caramelized.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound the cooked peppers into a coarse paste, then transfer the mixture to a large bowl.
Add the ground black pepper, red pepper flakes, and a pinch of salt to the bowl, then stir to combine.
